endorsements.name: Jeongwoo Lee
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-58399
endorsements.description: llama.cpp before b2731 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_model_loader that allows attackers to read memory outside the mapped model file via crafted GGUF tensor offsets. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated GGUF model file with arbitrary 64-bit tensor offsets to crash the process or load adjacent process memory as model weights.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)

endorsements.name: Jeongwoo Lee
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-58400
endorsements.description: llama.cpp before b3701 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_decode_internal and llama_encode_internal that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read memory by supplying unvalidated token IDs. Attackers can send integer-array prompts to the llama-server /completion endpoint with IDs outside 0 to n_vocab to read embedding memory out of bounds or crash the process.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.8)

endorsements.name: Jeongwoo Lee
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-71439
endorsements.description: llama.cpp before b5649 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in llama_vocab::impl::print_info() that allows attackers to crash model loading via oversized special token IDs. Attackers can supply a crafted GGUF model with a short tokenizer.ggml.tokens array, causing llama-cli or llama-server to read past id_to_token and crash.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.8)
